title.narrative: Partnerskabsaftale mellem DIIS og EVAL omkring faglige studier og forskning ifm evaluering af den danske udviklingsbistand

description.narrative: The office of evaluation, learning and quality (ELK) in the Danish MFA fulfils an important role with regards to the evaluation and learning in the development coorperation, both for the evidence-based strategy- and policy development and the specific implementation of development cooperation. DIIS has comprehensive knowledge and compentencies within the development cooperation and international work in general. The project will establish a partnership between DIIS and ELK with the purpose of contributing with learning and experience. DIIS will be used to increase the quality of evaluation work which is handled by ELK. The evaluations, which are independent will remain, with ELK's managing and in compliance with public tender rules, be outsourced to danish and foreign consultants and consultancy firms

department.narrative: Department for Evaluation, Learning and Quality (LEARNING)
